title: Transmission Eigenvalues and Non-scattering
summary: In this paper we survey some recent results concerning scattering and non-scattering in the context of the linear Helmholtz equation and inhomogeneities of nontrivial contrast. We examine isotropic as well as anisotropic media. Part of the survey deals with the so-called transmission spectrum, namely those wave numbers at which non-scattering potentially may occur. For wave numbers that are not transmission eigenvalues any incident wave leads to scattering, however, being at a transmission eigenvalue is far from su!cient to guarantee the occurence of non-scattering for even a single incident…
